property.name: openWindowDays
property.label: Open Window (Days)
property.description: Number of available dates to show. Set to 0 to use WorkType Timeframe End value automatically (recommended). To change dynamically: edit WorkType → Timeframe End in Setup.

property.name: redirectUrl
property.label: Post-Booking Redirect URL
property.description: URL to redirect after successful booking confirmation.

property.name: bookingType
property.label: Booking Type
property.description: PD, FSS, or IC (blank=IC). Leave blank to auto-detect from URL ?type= parameter.

LightningComponentBundle.description: Dynamic round-robin scheduler for IC, PD, and FSS bookings. Reads ?type=PD/FSS/IC from URL. IC creates Lead + SA; PD/FSS creates SA only with round-robin assignment.
